name: Classic 2D Platformer
description: Geared towards action platformers and Metroidvanias (Mega Man, Celeste, Hollow Knight). Side-view movement with ground-aligned footing, jump arcs, and attack combos.
prompt_prefix: pixel art 2d platformer sprite, clean side-view profile silhouette, ground-aligned feet, crisp pixel outlines, arcade action pose
negative_prompt: isometric, top down, 3d render, photorealistic, blurry, background scene, landscape, perspective distortion
